newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea steps in forex market again - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea steps in forex market again - dealers.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea (BOK) intervened in the interbank won/dollar market in Wednesday's afternoon trading to check the won's plunge against the dollar, dealers said.
They said the BOK stepped in the market for the third time in a day but the bank has never confirmed that it intervenes.
Dealers said the bank's massive dollar selling started as it hit 821.30 won. The intervention immediately pushed the dollar lower at 820.50/60 after touching 820.40, they said.
But demand for the greenback continued to be strong on dollar short-covering by some banks, they added.
